sourceClaims.claim: the raw Calendar authority establishes a Time header variant with standalone Past, Today and Future group labels above a distinct Date header variant; it also establishes their outer/inner fills, inset and corner geometry, today fill across demonstrated body-cell variants, and full-cell unavailable hatching while remaining byte-identical
the Showcase maps one past date, one today date and three future dates to exact colspans 1, 1 and 3; unavailable remains an independent attribute on two future columns
today body fill applies to every body cell in its column while past and future body cells retain the base surface
full-screen supplied exports show a dense operational row-by-date matrix and unavailable periods
native table markup, sticky context, declarative dates, generic tones, and disclosure form the reusable interface
sticky context degrades to ordinary table flow and rendered matrices remain bounded

evidence.source-integrity: pass: raw Calendar SHA-256 and unchanged-source diff are asserted; supplemental hashes are recorded separately
evidence.structural-contract: pass: native table markup exposes a standalone temporal colgroup row with exact Showcase colspans 1/1/3 above five independent date headers; package exports, docs, plain HTML, Showcase fixture and live consumer are classified
evidence.runtime-browser: pass: row/cell disclosure, typed bubbling events, repeat enhancement, teardown, row replacement/re-enhancement and consumer action execute
evidence.accessibility: pass: accessible table name, scope=colgroup temporal headers, independent scope=col date headers, cell header relationships, unavailable reason, native buttons and focus retention execute
evidence.focused-visual: pass: a dedicated header-row snapshot plus independent computed geometry, background, foreground, emphasis, separator, inner-surface inset and corner assertions prove Past/Today/Future groups and the Today body column; component-local desktop and narrow snapshots cover the source matrix
evidence.consumer-integration: pass: Data Workspace composition owns data and its native item action
evidence.responsive-content-stress: pass: narrow, two-axis overflow, long localized content, empty cells and enlarged text remain reachable

staticVisual: pass: source matrix and temporal/density snapshots remain static-visual evidence only
realInteractionVisual: pass: browser-created expanded and collapsed disclosure states expose computed visibility and focused-control outline while active
runtimeBehavior: pass: native activation updates hidden and aria-expanded, emits typed events, preserves focus, isolates roots and tears down

interactionEvidence.manualStateWalk: pass: inspected past/today/future outer and inner header treatments and full-column body paint, pointer, Tab/focus-visible, Enter/Space, expanded/collapsed, unavailable, narrow, 200-percent text and content-stress states on the Showcase and Data Workspace surfaces

knownLimitations: no virtualization or unbounded matrix guarantee
sticky positioning degrades where platform containment prevents it
all temporal and domain behavior remains consumer-owned
